preconditions.expression: isinstance(s, str) and len(s) > 0 and all(c.isalpha() for c in s)
preconditions.description: Input is a non-empty lowercase alphabetic string with no special characters.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == len(return_value), all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in return_value))
postconditions.description: Output is a string of the same length as input, containing only lowercase letters.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == s[i] if s[i] in 'y' else False for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: Characters not vowels or 'y' are transformed according to the rules.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == chr(((ord(s[i]) - ord('a') - 5) % 26) + ord('a')) if s[i] in 'aeiou' else False for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: Vowels are moved back 5 places in the alphabet, wrapping around from 'a' to 'z'.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == chr(((ord(s[i]) - ord('a') + 9) % 26) + ord('a')) if s[i] not in 'aeiouy' else False for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: Consonants (excluding 'y') are moved forward 9 places in the alphabet, wrapping around from 'z' to 'a'.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == chr(((ord(s[i]) - ord('a') - 1) % 26) + ord('a')) if s[i] == 'c' else False for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: 'c' is moved back 1 place in the alphabet.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == chr(((ord(s[i]) - ord('a') - 3) % 26) + ord('a')) if s[i] == 'o' else False for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: 'o' is moved back 1 place in the alphabet.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == chr(((ord(s[i]) - ord('a') - 4) % 26) + ord('a')) if s[i] == 'd' else False for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: 'd' is moved back 3 places in the alphabet.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == chr(((ord(s[i]) - ord('a') - 5) % 26) + ord('a')) if s[i] == 'e' else False for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: 'e' is moved back 4 places in the alphabet.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == s[i] if chr(((ord(s[i]) - ord('a') + shift) % 26) + ord('a')) in 'codoe' else False for i in range(len(s)) for shift in [-5, -1, -3, -4, 9])
postconditions.description: If a moved letter becomes 'c', 'o', 'd', or 'e', revert it back to its original value.
